steps.text: Oh... Rosmontis, what are you doing?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I... I wanna fix this terminal.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Six years of memories up to last year... I saved them all in here...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: This morning, I went to read the log from June 12, but the screen wouldn't turn on.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What if... what if I can't ever read them again...?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The March 14th log, when I went to the botanical gardens with daddy, or hiking in July, or the time when mommy...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Mommy...
D- don't cry! Listen, you're not great with screens, right?
Why not wait until Scout can help you fix it? Or Closure?
I'll take it to Closure for you. She'll fix it up lickety-split!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Scout...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Is Scout that one operator who moves around all quiet?
That's him! You know him?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: With that perfectly polished look... like a porcelain doll.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: There he is.
Huh...?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I had yet to hear your estimation of me. I now understand how weak it is.
When did you get here?!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You could say I have always been here. I am used to concealing myself.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: So Mr. Scout was here all along.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Why didn't Blaze sense it?
I... I wasn't paying attention. I just didn't notice!
Hey, if you were standing here all this time, why didn't you help her fix it?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Forgive me. We are mere moments from undertaking a mission. I must focus my energy on calibrating my weaponry.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You might ask Closure, or the good Mechanist to assist you.
Are you about to go save Dr. {@nickname}?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Yes.
Oh. You're going too.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: It's me we're talking about. If I didn't go, what kind of joke would Rhodes Island's elite operators be?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: And what did Ascalon say?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: The usual. She's not going. Always there with Kal'tsit, that one.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Did it ever occur to you... That now is perhaps not the optimal time?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: But it might be our last chance.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Chernobog is probably going to turn back deep into Ursus to avoid that Catastrophe. And a rescue operation in the Ursus interior is going to be damn near impossible.
I keep hearing you talk about it, but is this Dr. {@nickname} really worth all this?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Worth as much as Amiya and Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Have I met the Doctor?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Not yet. But you will soon.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Good. I want to know what the Doctor is like too.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I really, really want to.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You will, kitten.
By the way, Ace, there's an uninfected girl named GreyThroat on your team.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: I'm aware. She's been training in isolation.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Listen, Blaze. I've been working with her for a few months now. She has trouble expressing herself, but she's not a bad person.
She looked my teammate in the eye and asked, 'How hard could it be to be Infected?'

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: I know. But it might have been a legitimate question to her. She might really be curious.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: It's not my place to demand an operator turn her opinion on a dime. And GreyThroat has never once questioned orders.
I don't care. I'm not going to stand by and let her insult my teammates, and I sure as hell won't let her disgrace the struggle of the Infected.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Now's not the time. I can see the rage you're holding back. But really, not now.
She said it right in front of me!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Take a breath, Big Cat.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You have a task at hand yourself.
...I do.
Fine. We'll deal with it when you get back.
Since when is Ace more senior than me?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: When you take that tone, I start to think maybe you're screwing around.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: She may very well be mocking you.
When he goes two days without shaving, he'll definitely look way more senior.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Ace's beard is very manly.
Hahaha! I have to go move some stuff around. Got my own job to do, you know. Later.
Let's get a drink when I'm done!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Try not to puke this time.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Misery spent two hours scrubbing the floor. I wager he would vomit himself when faced with that task again.
Who knew you could hold your liquor so well!
Rosmontis, Mechanist will give you back your terminal in a bit.
Be a good girl and wait patiently. But don't forget either!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll definitely remember! Bye bye!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Don't burn yourself!
Relax. I can control my own Arts.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...How is it you went before me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ace, was some uninfected girl like GreyThroat really worth training?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How much trust did we earn? And how much trust did we give?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If the Doctor...

options: What are you saying over there?!
If I don't believe in Rhodes Island...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm saying bad things about you. To your face.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If there's a Doctor hanging around here, hurry up and come out already. You'll need some fancy Arts to hide behind that wall if you don't want me to find you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Then I'll string you up on a lamppost as bait for Reunion. Don't worry! You won't die. A few bolts and a knife or two never hurt anyone.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ....sigh.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sigh!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did Amiya send you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever. That's what she's best at. And what she's worst at...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I keep trying to remind her, to get her thinking about how she's still just a kid... it always seems to have the opposite effect.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I guess she'll never be able to put down that grown up persona of hers as long as she's the leader of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course, if it wasn't Amiya who sent you, if you decided to come keep me company all by yourself, I'm not against the idea.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Hold me back? Haha! I could carry three of you on my back and I wouldn't even notice. One little Dr. {@nickname} can't hold me back.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, look over there.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Go on! Get out of here! We don't want to fight!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Hmph... we won't yield to the Infected!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You're outnumbered! What's the point?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Duty!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Don't blame us for what happens! You see those monsters behind us? Just run already!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: What monsters?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: See that Reunion group cutting through the alleys? They're picking at Lungmen's vanguard units. They won't hold for long...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Give me a path.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The fastest, of course!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Don't give me that look. It's not like I've never carried you before.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Here we go! Smash Reunion and save the Lungmenites!
